authority.reason: The repository owner controls dependency and environment policy.

choices.summary: Move the optional dependency behind an explicit runtime boundary.

tradeoffs.maintainability: Keeps an optional dependency out of unrelated paths.
tradeoffs.quality: Preserves real proof without replacing the production path.
tradeoffs.reversibility: Reverts as one bounded adapter change.
tradeoffs.risk: Requires care to preserve existing behavior at the boundary.
tradeoffs.scope: One import boundary and focused regression coverage.

choices.summary: Install the optional dependency in every test environment.

tradeoffs.maintainability: Couples every test path to a platform-specific stack.
tradeoffs.quality: Exercises the production import path directly.
tradeoffs.reversibility: Dependency changes can be rolled back.
tradeoffs.risk: Hides an unnecessary eager import instead of removing it.

decision_context.question: How should the optional dependency be isolated for the focused proof?

expected_result.threshold: Zero unrelated import failures in the focused proof run.

recommendation.falsifier: Unrelated import failures drop to zero in a build where the import boundary was never applied, showing something else removed them.
recommendation.principal_uncertainty: Whether another entry point still imports it eagerly.
revisit_when: The optional dependency becomes required for every application entry point.
A second unrelated import failure appears outside the isolated boundary.
recommendation.why: It removes the unrelated import failure at the narrowest durable seam.

observation_context.action: Re-derive any status artifact on read rather than citing it.

authority.reason: Changing how status artifacts are consumed is the owner's call.

instances: a scheduled check-in asking to verify settled conditions
observation_context.recognition_heuristic: A status artifact is cited as current without anything re-checking it.
observation_context.refuted_if: Each artifact is re-derived at read time, so none can outlive its subject.
observation_context.statement: Recorded state outlives the thing it described.
